_comment: Template for a new challenges/round-N doc. Copy this file, fill in every field, delete this _comment, then run: node scripts/new-challenge.js your-file.json (dry-run) or add --apply to actually create it. Name, work email, department and entry type (individual/group) are ALWAYS collected by the submission form itself - never list them under requirements.
title: Challenge title shown everywhere (cards, hero, brief)
archiveName: Optional short label for the archive feed header; omit to reuse title
summary: One or two sentences shown on the dashboard hero and challenge list.
_page_comment: `page` is OPTIONAL. Omit it entirely for a simple round (the Challenges tab then shows the plain detail panel, same as every round without one). Only add it for a round that needs the full rich page (sections, design pack, interactive checklist, scoring) - see Round 9 (scripts/round9-page-content.js) for a complete real example and js/app.js's renderRichChallengePage() for how each field is used. Shape:

page.intro: Longer top-card description, replacing `summary` on the rich page only (summary is still used elsewhere - Dashboard hero, the simple panel).

why.lead: Lead paragraph for the 'Why this challenge' section.

brief.statement: The one-sentence brief, shown in a highlighted quote box.

mustHaves.text: the rest of the must-have sentence.

yourCall.label: Short category name, e.g. Layout
yourCall.text: What's left up to the entrant for this category.

page.sampleUrl: https://... a finished example entry to link from 'See a sample'

makeItYours.intro: Intro line for the 'Make it yours' section.
makeItYours.note: Closing callout line for this section.

steps.text: A step that shows the valid/invalid link-prefix check below it.
A plain step with no link or prefix check.

howToSubmit.invalidNote: Why that prefix is wrong, shown both in the 'Not this' box and in the submission form's soft warning.

checklist: Interactive self-check item shown in 'How to submit', separate from the top-level `checklist` above (that one's shown on the Submissions form's info card instead).
page.afterDeadlineNote: What, if anything, can still be fixed after the deadline.

scoring.intro: One sentence on how judging works.
scoring.validity: The completion of 'An entry is valid when ...' - what makes an entry countable at all.

criteria.name: Criterion name
criteria.full: What earns full marks on this criterion.
